''See also: [[Dragon King Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Seshethkunaaz]], known as the [[dragons|Dragon]] King, is the [[Monarch]] of the eastern [[Ashwind continent]]. He often traverses the desert appearing as a human boy with tanned skin, dark hair, sandy hair, and golden eyes, typically wearing a brown cloak. While he holds an admiration for humanity, he harbors a deep resentment toward human civilization due to its social structures that prioritize the weak over the strong. He is characterized by a sense of draconic pride and an inherent belief in the superiority of his kind. His influence is growing, and he possesses a totem that can project his [[Authority|authority]] and spirit, manifesting as a golden serpent or a crown of power. The [[dragons|Dragon]] King's subordinates include [[Xorrus]], the Desert-bringer, and [[Garrylondryth]], the [[Rootfather]], who once served as his right hand. The [[dragons]] themselves are viewed as destructive beings, yet the King has expressed a willingness to be satisfied by the pride shown in combat.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[dragons|Dragon]] King is a motivated leader who seeks to expand his influence through northern raids and seizing assets from the weakened [[Akura clan]]. He is deeply protective of his future champion, willing to do anything to ensure their safety. However, he has expressed dissatisfaction regarding the current direction of the contest.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[dragons|Dragon]] King engaged in combat with [[Malice]]. He also acts as a protector to an unnamed future champion.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[dragons|Dragon]] King's willpower is manifested as a gust of sand that takes the form of a snarling serpent.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Driven by a fierce desire to protect his future champion, the [[dragons|Dragon]] King remains deeply dissatisfied with how the contest has unfolded. During a confrontation with [[Malice]], his willpower manifests as a gust of sand shaped like a snarling serpent. Despite the escalating threat, he does not intend to advance further in the conflict.}}
